messages:
sam: Heads-up: We have a planned NAT flip for egress in us-east1 at 2026-03-28 03:00 UTC. This will require soft-draining a subset of GPU nodes to move sessions off before the iptables NAT change. Expected window ~30m.

marta: Which pools exactly? Any impact on Dedicated tenants or burst costs?

kyle: Targeting pool `gpu-us-east1-regular` (cohort-B subset) — ~220 GPUs. Dedicated pools are excluded unless we need overflow backfill. Plan is staged cordon + kv-cache priming.

nora: Ops plan summary: cordon 10 hosts -> evict tasks -> flip NAT on edge -> warmbackfill from saturn-pool for 15m -> run kv-seed -> uncordon. We'll keep cohorts small to avoid cold-cache storm.

ben: Do we need customer comms / status page? Any SLA exposure?

sam: I'll open a status incident and post to status page. SLA risk low but app-level latency p95 might spike during eviction. Cost: estimated burst backfill ~3k tokens/min peak, ~USD 120 total for the window (estimate).

kyle: Note: some KV cache entries live on evicted nodes and will be invalidated. Recommend running a targeted kv-seed for top routes after the flip to avoid quality regressions.

nora: Suggested kv-seed command after NAT flip:
```
kubectl run kv-seeder --image=internal/kv-seeder:prod --restart=OnFailure -- /seed \  
  --prefix=top100 \  
  --rate=200/s
```
We'll gate it so it doesn't overload edge.

deploy-bot: Scheduled rollout job created: `roll/7360001234`. Steps (automated): cordon -> evict -> nat-flip -> kv-seed -> uncordon. Manual approval required before nat-flip.

marta: Important: egress IP rotation might break third-party allowlists. We'll need to email partners + provide old->new mapping. If any partner fails we'll hold the flip for 15m to investigate.

ben: On-call coverage? Finance sign-off?

kyle: On-call: @kyle and @nora covering 02:30-04:00 UTC. Finance: cost estimate posted, no blockers.

sre-bot: Monitoring hooks set: `latency.p95.gpu_us_east1`, `errors.rate.gpu_us_east1`. Alerts: p95>300ms or errors>0.5% -> pager to #eng-oncall.

kyle: Operational tweak: reduce batching during the flip to lower queue buildup. Propose `batch.max_tokens=128` -> `96` for ~45m around the window.

nora: I'll push a canary with that batch config to cohort-A 15m before the flip to validate impact.

sam: Post-flip smoke tests (automated): `curl -s https://api.redwood/test?route=chat` x50 across regions + simple L2 accuracy check.

marta: I'll draft customer comms with time, expected impact, and rollback criteria. Will share in ~30m. :thumbsup:

ben: Finance: please confirm final cost after post-mortem.

kyle: Cost estimate and runbook uploaded: https://internal/ops-costs/7360001234

sam: Thanks. Final preflight call at 01:45 UTC in #eng-infra for go/no-go. Please ack if you can make it.

marta: ack

kyle: ack

nora: ack
